entities.summary: Konrad Tomasz Lewandowski is a fantasy and science fiction writer, journalist, and doctor of philosophy, best known for a science/political fiction series on the adventures of tabloid journalist Radosław Tomaszewski; and for a fantasy series about a werecat Ksin.
